title: Cyprus Mushroom Finder — growing conditions summary
safety: Conditions only. Never eat a wild mushroom based on this map, an app or an AI.
how_to_read: Scores 0-100 = how good GROWING CONDITIONS are (rain, temperature, soil moisture, season for the altitude, shade) in ~2 km forest zones. It never says a mushroom is there, and never says anything about eating one. Nature reserves are closed and never listed. Confidence: high = days 0-2, medium = 3-4, low = 5+ (forecast). Picking rules: no rakes or tools; pick by hand or knife; put the leaf litter back.
emergency: Poisoning: call 112. Cyprus Poison Centre: 1401. Do not wait for symptoms.
